fields.label: conventions.routing
fields.value: Expo Router file-based routing — app/ directory with route groups: (banking) for authenticated user screens, (admin) for admin screens, (tabs) for tab navigation

fields.label: conventions.state_management
fields.value: Module-level singleton stores (AuthStore in store/auth.ts, api in store/api.ts, banking store in store/banking.ts) — no Redux/Zustand

fields.label: conventions.api_client
fields.value: Centralized api object in store/api.ts; all calls go through request() helper with Bearer token auth header

fields.label: conventions.token_storage
fields.value: JWT stored in AsyncStorage under key auth_token; in-memory cache (_memToken) for sync access

fields.label: conventions.styling
fields.value: StyleSheet.create() per file; theme constants in constants/theme.ts (BSColors palette)

fields.label: conventions.test_ids
fields.value: testID props used on key UI elements for automation (e.g. testID=email-input, testID=bs-logo, testID=password-input)

fields.label: auth_pattern.type
fields.value: JWT + OTP two-factor authentication

fields.label: auth_pattern.demo_credentials_pattern
fields.value: Demo autofill buttons exist on login screen (app/index.tsx) for regular user and wrong-password scenarios. OTP screen shows server OTP as a hint in demo mode; static fallback OTP also available. See app/index.tsx autoFillRegular() for credential pattern.

fields.label: auth_pattern.admin_role
fields.value: Same login flow as regular user; role field in JWT payload determines routing to admin screens under app/(admin)/

fields.label: repo_intent.summary
fields.value: Demo mobile banking app (BrowserStack Bank) — Expo/React Native frontend + Express.js backend. Features: login, OTP 2FA, biometric auth, liveness/KYC, Stripe payments, transfers, cards, transactions, shop, admin controls. Built as a BrowserStack demo app for mobile testing.

fields.label: monorepo.layout
fields.value: Two components: (1) mobile-app at repo root — Expo 54, React Native 0.81.5, TypeScript, expo-router; (2) server at server/ — Express.js 4, JavaScript, Neon serverless PostgreSQL

fields.label: auth_pattern.login_flow
fields.value: POST /auth/login → JWT token → stored in AsyncStorage (key: auth_token) + in-memory. Redirect to /otp → POST /auth/send-otp → 6-digit OTP (shown as hint in demo). POST /auth/verify-otp → routes to /(banking)/home. Signup: POST /auth/signup → OTP → /liveness for KYC. API uses Authorization Bearer header. Server validates via authMiddleware (jsonwebtoken).
